name: botbridge-webcam
displayName: Bot Bridge Webcam — Local Camera MCP Server for Copilot Chat
description: Give GitHub Copilot Chat and VS Code agents a local webcam over MCP: take photos and record clips on demand. Local-only, nothing is uploaded. Pro desktop Helper sold separately.

commands.title: Bot Bridge Webcam: Refresh MCP Server

botbridge-webcam.enabled.markdownDescription: Register the local webcam MCP server with VS Code. When off, no MCP server is offered and no camera process is started.

botbridge-webcam.uvPath.markdownDescription:
Path to the [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) executable used to launch the local webcam MCP server. Use an absolute path if `uv` is not on the VS Code `PATH`.

_Machine scope:_ this can only be set in user settings, never per workspace, so a cloned repository cannot redirect the executable that gets launched.

botbridge-webcam.packageSpec.markdownDescription:
Python package spec for the local webcam MCP server, passed to `uv run --with`. Defaults to the fork that exposes the `webcam_panel` tool, pinned to an immutable commit (the commit behind tag `v0.2.0`). Advanced users may point this at a local build path.

_Machine scope:_ this can only be set in user settings, never per workspace, so a cloned repository cannot inject an arbitrary package that this extension would execute.

botbridge-webcam.cameraIndex.markdownDescription: Camera device index passed to the webcam MCP server (0 = default camera).

botbridge-webcam.photoWidth.description: Default captured photo width in pixels.

botbridge-webcam.photoHeight.description: Default captured photo height in pixels.
